# Community teams statistics

<!-- Generated from in-app Help; do not edit by hand. -->

Each community team's patients in a bed, and those with a discharge date.

## What is on the screen

1. Teams at a glance. Team patients in a bed, those with a discharge date, teams with someone in a bed and people in a bed with no team.
2. Statistics views. Network, Compare, Services, Wards, EDs, Teams and Weekly. Each opens its own page.
3. Teams by service. How many of each service's team patients are in a bed.
4. Teams with someone in a bed. In a bed lists only teams with someone in a bed. All lists every team.

## On a phone

- Find a team. Type a team's name to find it in the list.
- Teams. With patients lists the teams with someone in a bed. All teams lists every team.

In BedChart, open Help and choose Show me around this screen to see each part lit in turn.

_Prototype on synthetic data. Not for real patients._
